'''Leezeldafuzz Lee's SWCCG LS Space Deck (revised)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Leezeldafuzz]]
* '''Published:''' 10 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 TRM Leezeldafuzz LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

Squadron Assignments/Get to Your Ships (same card) Rules!

Comments wanted.

== Strategy ==

First I use Strike Planning to pull General Dodonna and put him at Yavin: Throne room (if I can), or I use GTYS and SA to play 2 ship/pilot combos if I/opponent plays a system.

Then I keep pulling pilots with Dodonna and using GTYS and SA to get their ships. The only bad thing about Dodonna is that you can only pull pilots of ability <3.(which is like a good majority of the pilots i have with matching ships.)

I control space! Force drain away baby!

Mwahahahahahahahahahaha!!!  :)

(Unfortunately, guys, I don't have any of those cards. The only way i can pull locations is Mindful, and thats only battlegrounds. I'll probably pull Aquaris to boost my Force generation.)
